info.name: Aeza - Shopify Admin API (brand store)
info.description: Part A: the exact Shopify Admin GraphQL calls the Aeza Partner app makes (needs `shop` + `access_token`; get a token with `npm run store:token -- --shop <shop>`, it expires after ~1 hour). Part B: the Aeza app's own endpoints (order API, nightly sync). See docs/aeza-shopify-data-sync-guide.pdf.

item.name: A1. One product with all variants (used by product webhooks)
A2. Browse products, 10 per page (same fields as the full sync)
A3. Start full catalog export (bulk operation, what install + nightly sync run)

request.description: Only reads products. Shopify sends bulk_operations/finish to the app when done, which makes the live app re-import the catalog (harmless).

item.name: A4. Latest export status + download URL (open `url` to see the JSONL)
A5. Stock for one inventory item (used by inventory_levels/update)
A6. Shop currency (used before creating an order)

request.description: Creates a REAL paid order in the brand's Shopify store (tagged 'Aeza Test', stock reduced). Run on a dev store, or with the brand's agreement. Send it twice: the 2nd response must be 200 with duplicate: true.
Starts a full catalog export for every connected store. Response: {started, failed, prunedWebhookEvents}.
